(547)༄/gnam chos dbag gi las slob kyi phyag bzhes bltas tshad kun grol bzhugs/ /(548)na mo gu ra we/mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba che/ /lhan skyes rda

tei:div.tei:p: (547)༄/ gnam chos dbag gi las slob kyi phyag bzhes bltas tshad kun grol bzhugs// (548)na mo gu ra we/ mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba che// lhan skyes rdo rje'i bdag nyid can// gter chen bla mar phyag byas te// dbang gi 'grigs rim bsnyel tho 'bri// de la khyab bdag kun bzang shes rab kyi sgyu 'phrul rig 'dzin chen po mdo sngags bstan 'dzin gyi dbang gi lag len gsal byed nor bu'i me long bzhin du bshams sgrub zin nas/ tshe dpag skor gyi tshe dbang rgyas pa'i dbang dngos la/ khrus/ sngon gtor/ bka' bsgo/ mtshams bcad/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma/ lo rgyus/ gsol gdab/ bdun rnam dag/(?) mig dar/ me tog gtad/ sgo dbye/ slob ma lhar bskyed/ byin 'bebs/ brtan/ tshe 'gugs/ me tog dor/ mig dbye/ mthong ba bstan/ cod pan spyi bor/ rnam bum/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ 'khor lo/ rgya gram/ sku tsaka 36 nyi ma zla ba/ 'brug lcags kyu/ mda' dar/ tshe nas/ tshe chang*/ tshe sha/ tshe ril/ gsang thod/ rig tsaka shel rdo dang rma bya/ gzugs mdzes mi mdzes/ sgra snyan mi snyan/ dri zhim mi zhim/ ro mngar skyur/ reg bya 'jam rtsub/ mtha' rten/ gdugs/ nya/ pad+ma/ bum (549)pa/ dpal be/ 'khor lo/ rgyal mtshan ste rtags brgyad dang*/ 'khor lo/ nor bu/ blon dpon/ btsun mo/ glang po/ rta mchog/ dmag dpon te sna bdun/ gtor dbang*/ tshe thil bcas/ tshe dbang 'bring po la/ bum pa/ sku/ phreng ba/ tshe chang ril/ mar me/ mda' bcas/ bsdus pa la/ bum pa/ gtor ma bcas/ phyi sgrub la gzungs dbang bsdus pa bskur dgos pa de rigs la/ bum pa/ gtor ma/ sku tsaka/ mar me/ 'bras snying*/ dung dkar/ zhir dbyug thod phreng bcas thams cad la 'gres/ nang sgrub la gzungs dbang*/ gsang sgrub la gzungs dbang*/ yang gsang la gzungs dbang bcas kyis grol/ phyi tshogs la/ bde chen zhing dbang la/ bum pa/ sku/ gtor ma/ rdo rje lhung bzad bcas/ snang mtha' la/ bum pa/ dung*/ dpal bo/ pad+ma/ 'khor lo/

rgyal mtshan/ gdugs/ nya/ lcags kyu/ ral gri bcas/ snang mtha' tshe sgrub la gzungs dbang*/ 'od dpag med la gzungs dbang*/ tshe dpag smyug rgod la gzungs dbang*/ rgya mtsho tshe sgrub la gzungs dbang*/ thugs rje tshe sgrub la gzungs dbang*/ chos grags rgya mtshor gzungs dbang*/ ḍoṃ bhi par gzungs dbang*/ lo gyon la gtor dbang*/ (550) bka' srung gsum por/ sku/ dbu rgyan/ cod pan/ me long bcas/ zhal bzhi par gzungs dbang bcas kyis grol/ phyi dror/ thugs rje chen po lus dkyil la/ gzungs dbang byin rlabs 'dod 'jo la/ bum pa/ gsang thod/ rig tsaka/ man shel/ rma bya'i mdangs/ gtor ma/ sku/ mar me/ 'bras snye/ dung*/ zhing dbyug thod phreng bcas/ rten sgrub la gzungs dbang*/ phyag stong rgyas pa la gzungs dbang*/ 'brib por gzungs dbang*/ bsdus pa gzungs dbang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gzungs dbang*/ rgya mtsho'i tshe sgrub gzungs dbang*/ pad+ma gtsug gtor gzungs dbang*/ bhu su ku ting 'dzin dbang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen po gzungs dbang*/ rnga yab gling pa gzungs dbang*/ phyi tshogs la/ rdor sems la gzungs dbang*/ rta mgrin gzungs dbang*/ tshogs bdag gzungs dbang*/ brag lha gzungs dbang*/ mdung 'dzin la/ gtor ma/ rdo rje rgod la gzungs dbang*/ me 'bar rdo rje gzungs dbang*/ rdo rje dug ri gzungs dbang*/ kha dmar gzungs dbang*/ glang bdud gzungs dbang bcas so/ nyin gnyis pa la/ lha lngar/ bum pa/ phreng ba/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ shel phreng*/ ral gri/ gtor ma/ snang ba mtha' yas la/ bum pa/ (551)thod chang*/ rdo rje/ po ti/ sku gzugs bcas/ thugs rje chen po la dbang snang ba mtha' yas bshad ma thag pa ltar dang*/ lha mang la dbang de ltar/ o rgyan dbang de ltar/ mtsho rgyal dbang de ltar/ dam can dbang de ltar gyis grol/ tsha rting la/ thugs rje chen po rigs lnga'i skor la/ 'gro 'dul la/ bum pa/ sku gzugs bcas/ rin 'phel la/ bum pa/ sku/ phreng ba bcas/ rgyal gsung ma la/

bum pa/ sku/ nor bu bcas/ don zhags la/ bum pa/ sku/ sked ching dmar ser bcas/ 'khor chen la/ bum pa/ sku/ smad g.yogs bcas/ tshe dpag smyug rgod gzungs dbang*/ pad 'byung sku gsum gzungs dbang*/ o rgyan sde brgyad gzungs dbang*/ dzaṃ ser gzungs dbang bcas kyi grol/ bar tshogs la par+ṇaiya'i (?)skor la/ 'od dkar can la gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ birba pa la gzungs dbang*/ mi tra dz+wa ki'i gzungs dbang*/ thod phreng rigs lnga gzungs dbang*/ sa snying gzungs dbang*/ rnam 'joms gzungs dbang/ gnam lcags pha lam gzungs dbang*/ a dkar tsa du la chos skyong spyi'i bka' gtad sbyar dgos pas 'di rigs la/ sku gzugs/ nas dkar po/ gtor ma/ phyag mtshan lcags spyang mgo dgu dang lcags kyu bcas thams cad la (552)'gre/ nas/ lha mdog phyag mtshan so sor dgos pas/ phyag mtshan so sor/ tsa du ya sngon po la bka' gtad gong ltar/ nas sngon po/ phyag na phur pa khram shing*/ tsa du than bdag la bka' gtad gong ltar/ nas dud kha/ sbal pa mgo dgus sbrul mgo dgur bzhon pa dang sbrul zhags/ tsa du srog gcod la bka' gtad/ nas dmar po/ gri mdung*/ tsa du kun 'dus bka' gtad/ nas khra bo/ gri mda' gzhu/ tsa du nak+ṣa bka' gtad/ nas nag po/ chu srin rkyal pa/ sbrul zhags/ tsa du hi li ha'i bka' gtad/ nas ser skya/ me long dang*/ mda' dar/ tsa du spar ba'i bka' gtad/ nas dmar ser/ ga'u/ lhung bzed/ tsa du ma ra bka' gtad/ nas dmar skya/ me long dang khram shing bcas/ tshogs grol/ dgung tshogs la/ lha dgu'i skor las/ bum pa/ spyanagazigs sku/ rin chen/ ma ning*/ gro lod/ gur drag snang mtha'/ o rgyan/ khros ma/ phag mo'i sku/ gtor ma bcas/ gsang 'dus yab yum gzungs dbang*/ gsang 'dus dmar po'e gzungs dbang*/ gsang 'dus lo ka'i gzungs dbang*/ gsang 'dus smug po'i gzungs dbang*/ dzam la rigs dgu'i gzungs dbang bcas kyis grol/ nyin gsum pa'i zhog tshogs la/ rnam bkra'i skor gyi rtsa dbang la/

mig dar/ me tog byin 'bebs rjes mig dbye/ sgo dbye la/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ (553)lcags sgrog dril bu'i tsaka li dkyil 'khor gyi pyogs bzhir bzhag me tog dor/ bu pa/ gtor ma/ bum pa/ thod chang dang pad+ma dmar po/ me long ral gri/ phreng ba/ pad+ma/ ting shag nor bu/ rlung bzung*/ gtor ma bcas so/ tshe dbang bdud rtsi'i gegs sel la/ bla mas 'dod yon lnga'i phyag rgya bca'/ bum dbang*/ pad+ma/ rdo rje/ nor bu/ rta/ so mang*/ sngags byang*/ gter bdag/ mda' dar/ sku tsaka bcas/ tshe dpag med gzungs dbang*/ 'gro 'dul gzungs dbang*/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa gzungs dbang bcas so/ tsha rting la/ lha'i thub pa'i gzungs dbang*/ lha min thub pa'i gzungs dbang*/ mi'i thub pa'i gzungs dbang*/ dud 'gro'i thub pa'i gzungs dbang*/ yi dwags thub pa'i gzungs dbang*/ dmyal ba'i thub pa'i gzungs dbang*/ shing lo ma'i gzungs dbang*/ rnam sras dmar po'i bka' gtad spyi rgyug la/ sku nas dmar/ gtor ma/ phyag mtshan lcags kyu nor bu le bcas so/ bar tshogs la/ skye'u sgrub/ dgur tshogs skabs de'i dbang chen la/ khrus/ sngon gtor dpe'u ris ltar/ bskrad/ srung*/ lo rgyus/ maṇ+ḍal/ (554)slob ma lhar bskyed/ ma ṇi brgya bzla/ ye shes dbab brtan/ bum dbang*/ gtor ma/ sku tsaka dgu/ dngul gyi me long*/ durba/ gi waṃ/ yungs dkar/ li khri/ bil ba/ dung dkar/ zho/ 'khor lo/ nor bu/ blon po/ btsun mo/ glang po/ rta mchog dmag dpon/ dril bu/ rdo rje/ zhags pa/ lcags kyi zhags pa/ me long*/ seng ldeng ḍā ru/ dung dkar/ rus rkang g.yab dar nag po/ lha'i gu ru'i sku tsaka/ lha min gu ru/ mi'i/ byol song gi/ yi dwags kyi/ dmyal ba'i gu ru/ lha'i thub pa/ lha min/ mi'i/ byol song gi/ yi dwags kyi/ dmyal ba'i thub pa/ shel phreng*/ gdugs ser so/ nya/ dung dkar/ pad+ma/ bum pa/ dpal be'u/ 'khor lo/ rgyal mtshan/ pi waṃ/ mda' gzhu/ lhung bzed/ po ti/ sgrom bu/ chu snod dang dpal 'bar/ yul 'khor srung gi sku tsaka/

'phags skyes po/ spyan mi bzang*/ rnam thos sras/ gnas so gnyis kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo'i sku tsaka 64 bcas so// grub thob rgya gar rgyal la gzungs dbang bcas so// nyin bzhi par sgrub thabs rgya mtsho la/ zhog tshogs dus/ snang ba mtha' yas la/ bum pa/ gtor ma/ sku tsaka bum (555)pa pad+ma rdo rje me long bcas/ kun tu bzang po la dbang gong gi snang mtha' ltar la/ phyag mtshan me long gi tshab/ mnyam bzhag tshe dpag med la dbang gor ltar la/ phyag mtshan tshe bum/ thugs rje chen po la dbang de ltar/ phreng ba/ shākaya'i rgyal po la dbang de bzhin/ lhung bzed/ pad+ma 'byung gnas la dbang gong mtshungs bhan+dha bcas so/ tsha rting la/ bka' brgyad dbang la/ bum pa/ gtor ma sku gzugs gtsug pa/ dung dkar bcas/ dgongs 'dus la dbang de bzhin/ phur pa la dbang gor ltar/ gur drag la dbang gong bzhin/ che mchog la dbang gong 'dra/ pad rgyal la dbang sngar bzhin/ gro lod la dbang sngar ltar/ drag nag la dbang gong mtshungs/ phyag rdor la dbang de ltar/ rta mgrin la dbang de mtshungs/ khro chu la dbang de 'dra/ 'jigs byed la dbang ji lta/ gshed dmar la dbang ji bzhin/ gshed nag la dbang sngar mtshungs/ 'jam rdor la dbang gong gi rjes phyogs bcas so/ bar tshogs la/ mtsho rgyal la dbang*/ bum pa/ sku gzugs/ gtor ma/ phyag mtshan thod chang bcas/ dbyangs can (556)mar dbang mtsho rgyal dbang de ltar la/ phyag mtshan pi wang mda' dar me long*/ phag mo la dbang de bzhin la/ phyag mtshan gri thod/ kha ṭaṃ ral gri rdo rje/ mdung thung*/ khros ma la dbang de mtshungs la phyag mtshan/ rdo rje/ kha ḍaṭaṃ thod khrag ting shag lo ma can la dbang gong bzhin la/ phyag mtshan rma bya/ mda' gzhu/ dbu rgyan/ shing lo/ go mtshon/ rus rgyan/ seng gdong mar dbang gong ltar la/ phyag mtshan/ gri thod/ rdor dril/ khaṭaṃ shing lo/ kun tu bzang mo la dbang gong mtshungs la/ rdor dril/ yi ge drug ma la dbang sngar ltar la/ rdo rje/ phreng ba/ gri/ dril bu/ mdung*/

sgrol dkar la dbang gong mtshungs thog mchog sbyin ut+pal/ sgrol sngon la dbang sngar bzhin la/ pad+ma ut+pal/ khro gnyer mar snga ma rnams ji lta ba la/ gri thod rdo rje gri bcas so/ dgung tshogs la/ dpal mgon ma ning dbang la/ gtor ma/ bum pa/ sku gzugs bcas/ k+ṣeṭa pā lar dbang ma ning bzhin/ phyag bzhi par dbang de bzhin/ phyag drug pa dbang de ltar/ nor lha shan par dbang de mtshungs/ ber rtseg dbang de 'dra/ rdor legs dbang (557)gong bzhin/ mgar nag dbang gong ltar byas pas grub bo/ nyin lnga par/ gnas bcu'i skor gyi rtsa ba'i dbang chen la/ mig dar/ me tog las bum/ dam chu/ rdo rje/ me tog dor/ byin 'bebs/ brtan/ mig dbye/ lha ngo bstan/ bum pa/ sku rtsag 25 mkhar bsil/ lhung bzed/ mkhar bsil/ lhung bzed/ mkhar bsil/ lhung bzed/ spos phor/ rnga yab/ mnyam bzhag sdigs mdzub/ rnga yab/ sna gor/ sdigs mdzub/ chos 'chad/ mnyam bzhag nor bu/ zhags pa/ mnyam bzhag nor bu/ ne'u le/ rin chen/ brog zhu/ mnyam bzhag glegs bam/ po ti/ chos 'chad/ bum pa/ gseg shang*/ po ti/ mchod rten/ rnga yab/ bum pa/ po ti/ bye ru/ a ru ra/ pi waṃ/ ral gri/ mchod rten/ sbrul zhags/ rgyal mtshan/ ne'u le/ lcags kyu/ bzlas lung la phreng ba/ gtor dbang bcas/ tsha rting la/ gu ru zhi ba'i chos skor gyi rtsa dbang la/ bum pa/ po ti/ gtor ma/ thig le ser po/ mtsho rgyal sku bcas/ par 'byung sgrub thabs bsdus pa la gzungs dbang*/ mtshan brgyad la gzungs (558)dbang*/ rnal 'byor rgyun dbang la/ bum pa/ thig le dkar po/ dbu rgyan/ pad 'byung sku tsag/ pad+ma dkar dmar/ thig le dmar po/ nor bu/ mchod rten dmar po/ rdo rje rtse gcig thig le sngon po/ ri rab/ nor bu/ gu ru'i na bza'/ thig le ser po/ seng khri bcas/ spyan gzigs yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gzungs dbang*/ rgyal gsung lha lnga gzungs dbang ngam lha lnga'i dbang bskur na/ bum pa/ shel phreng*/ rdo rje/ phreng ba/ pad+ma/ me tog/

nor bu/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ gtor dbang bcas/ lha bzhi la gzungs dbang*/ spyan gzigs seng sgra la gzungs dbang bcas so/ bar tshogs la/ sman bla'i dbang gi khrus zin nas/ bgegs gtor skabs slob dpon mdun du ka tor chen po'i dbus su lcog rdog bzhag de'i mthar/ nad pa shog bkra'i rgyab yig gsungs rim bzhin g.yas bsgor du tsaka li dgu bkram/ mthar tsaka li bcas phyir dor/ gzungs dbang bskur/ rigs gsum dril sgrub la gzungs dbang*/ rdo rje lod la gzungs dbang*/ bi ma lar gzungs dbang*/ dam pa rgya gar gzungs dbang*/ rat+na gling pa'i phyi sgrub gzungs dbang*/ nad sgrub gzungs dbang*/ gsang sgrub gzungs (559)dbang*/ dbyangs can ma gzungs dbang bcas/ dgong tshogs la/ jo bo tshogs bdag bka' gtad spyi 'gro ma la/ sku/ me tog dmar po/ gtor ma/ phyag mtshan nor bu/ lcags kyu/ ne'u li/ zhags pa bcas/ zhing skyong dkar po la bka' gtad de bzhin/ nas dkar po/ phyag mtshan ru mtshon dmar po/ gri thod/ mkhar nag la bka' gtad sngar bzhin la/ nas nag po/ nor bu sbrul zhags/ dam can la bka' gtad sngar ltar la/ nas dmar po/ rdo rje ne'u le/ mi mgon dkar po la bka' gtad sngar mtshungs la/ nas dkar po/ bum pa/ mkha' ri la bka' gtad gong bzhin/ nas dkar/ mdung*/ spyang thod thun bkang*/ spo ma ra la bka' gtad gong mtshungs la/ nas dkar po/ mdung dar/ bum pa/ o rgyan dkrug yig la gzungs dbang bcas so/ nyin drug par/ ming gi mngon rdzogs skor las/ pad+ma saṃ bha rab byung can gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ thub tshab gzungs dbang*/ pad steng gzungs dbang*/ skyabs sbyin gzungs dbang/ zor lpags gzungs dbang*/ dkar mche gzungs dbang*/ saṃ bha gzungs dbang bcas/ tsha rting la/ blo ldan shar gyur gzungs dbang (560)rgyas pa/ mkhas pa'i gzungs dbang*/ sngags pa'i gzungs dbang*/ ḍa 'akrol gzungs dbang*/ ban 'dzin gzungs dbang*/ gau sngon gzungs dbang*/ blo ldan gzungs dbang*/ lnga mkhas gzungs dbang*/

pad zla'i gzungs dbang*/ nyi dbu'i gzungs dbang*/ me ldan gzungs dbang*/ mchog sred gzungs dbang bcas so/ bar tshogs la(?)/ seng sgra sbrul rgyan can gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ seng lpags gzungs dbang*/ so 'khrol gzungs dbang*/ sdang mig gzungs dbang*/ rngams sgra'i gzungs dbang*/ dgra non gzungs dbang*/ mu stegs bsgral gzungs dbang*/ bstan pa gso gzungs dbang*/ sgra sgrogs gzungs dbang*/ pad+ma rgyal po che gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ gzi brjid ldan gzungs dbang*/ dmar chen gzungs dbang*/ pad bzhugs gzungs dbang*/ zla gzhugs gzungs dbang*/ pad rgyal gzungs dbang bcas so/ dgung tshogs la/ shāka seng mdog ser gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ dbang gdan gzungs dbang*/ rdor gdan gzungs dbang*/ nyi mkhyen gzungs dbang*/ sprul byed gzungs dbang*/ mgon byed gzungs dbang*/ rdor 'dzin gzungs dbang*/ ser 'khyug (561)gzungs dbang*/ mdzod can gzungs dbang*/ rdor bsnams gzungs dbang*/ shāka seng gzungs dbang bcas so/ nyin bdun pa la/ lha mchog dam pa la/ bum pa/ gtor ma/ ut+pal/ paṇa zhwa/ po ti/ me tog phreng ba/ thod khrag tsit+ta/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ phur pa/ tho ba/ dpal be'u/ me tog rgya gram/ gser tog gser bre/ rna rgyan/ dngul bre/ g.yu bre/ spra ma/ ke ke/ ke ru/ pad gdan/ zhwa khra/ pa ru/ sbrul chun/ rus sbal mgo/ lcags gtun mde'u bcas/ sbrul mgo/ chu srin mgo/ zhal bu/ gaṇ+ḍi yog bcas/ sgro mdangs zhwa tog glang chen/ ngang pa shing lo khur ba/ mgon sku phyag bzhi/ spir/ rgyal mtshan/ rkang dung*/ thod ḍa/ ting shag pyag rgya sna tshogs/ mchod pa'i lha mo lnga bcas so/ se ba khrag 'thung bka' gtad spyi 'gro la/ sku/ nas dmar ser/ dmar gtor/ thod khrag bcas/ tsha rting la gro lod 'bir byed la gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ khon byed gzungs dbang*/ stag zhon gzungs dbang*/ bya zhon gzungs dbang*/ seng zhon gzungs dbang*/ gsod gcod gzungs dbang*/ (662)grus 'gong gzungs dbang*/ tshu rtsal gzungs dbang*/

nyi 'dzin gzungs dbang/ zla 'dzin gzungs dbang*/ skar 'dzin gzungs dbang*/ gro lod gzungs dbang bcas so/ bar tshogs la/ phyag rdor 'bar ma la gzungs dbang rgyas pa'am aṃ tsug ltar bskur na/ bum pa/ dung dkar/ rdo rje/ sku gzugs/ gtor ma bcas so/ gong gi phyag rdor mtha' yas la gzungs dbang*/ nam mkha'i bdag po gzungs dbang*/ lag gnas gzungs dbang*/ 'phang brgyad gzungs dbang*/ seng sgra gzungs dbang*/ dmigs pa gzungs dbang*/ lugs pa gzungs dbang*/ rgyug 'grod gzungs dbang*/ bla ma can gzungs dbang*/ ag tshom ldan gzungs dbang*/ me sgra gzungs dbang*/ phyag rdor gzungs dbang*/ aṃ tshug can la/ bum pa/ dung dkar/ rdo rje/ sku gzugs/ gtor ma bcas so/ dgong tshogs la/ king kang dmar byed gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ gso byed gzungs dbang*/ 'khor byed gzungs dbang*/ tho can gzungs dbang*/ 'gugs byed gzungs dbang*/ brdung byed gzungs dbang*/ me mdog gzungs dbang*/ dgra zlog gzungs dbang*/ 'bigs nad gzungs (563)dbang*/ shi hur gzungs dbang*/ gcod pa gzungs dbang*/ tog tse gzungs dbang*/ ma ca gzungs dbang*/ ha ri gzungs dbang*/ king kang smug po'i gzungs dbang bcas so/ nyin brgyad par/ dhe ru pa'i gro lod gzungs dbang*/ phyag rdor gzungs dbang*/ dhe ru'i srog dbang la/ bum pa/ sku tsaka gtso bo lnga 'khor bzhi/ sde brgyad rnams re re bzhin dang*/ ram pa'i dmar gtor khru gang pa'i rtser/ gtso bo'i tsaka li gzugs la dbang bskur/ de ba/ lde mig se ra/ hor gyi rā tsa/ shi ro bho bh+yo/ zlog bh+yo/ bho gsum rnams ram gtor la rim par btsugs shing dbang bskur/ gro yi lha bshos chen po la/ lha/ gshin rje/ ma mo/ bdud/ btsan rgyal po/ gnod sbyin/ klu rnams kyi tsaka li rim par btsugs la dbang bskur/ gtor ma gnyis gso bran byas la gtor 'bul lhan 'don tshigs bcad rdzogs dus/ slob dpon gyis gtor ma gnyis rang gi spyi bor bzhag zin nas/

me sgron/ gser skyems bcas phyi rol gtsang sar gshegs/ tsha rting la/ dhe ru chos skyong bcu'i dang po dbang (564)phyug la/ bka' gtad rgyas pa spyi 'gro la/ sku gzugs/ nas dmar po/ dmar gtor/ rdo rje ne'u le/ ngan chen la/ sku gzugs/ nas dud kha/ gtor ma gru bzhi ser po/ dung dkar/ gza' la/ sku/ nas nag po/ gtor ma g.yas kyus bya mgo/ rdo rje ral dri mda' gzhu rgyal mtshan/ bsnyo kha la/ sku/ nas dud ka/ dmar gtor sbrul dkris/ sbrul zhags/ shan pa la/ sku/ nas dmar/ dmar gtor/ gri thod/ gri/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ beg rtse la/ sku/ nas dmar/ dmar gtor/ mda' gzhu nor bu ral dri glo snying*/ mgar nag la/ sku/ nas nag po/ dmar gtor ra mgo can/ tho ba sbud pa/ mgar dmar la/ sku/ nas dmar/ dmar gtor ra mgo can/ rdo rje snying*/ g.yu sgron mar/ sku/ nas dkar/ bshos zlum dkar po/ nor bu me long*/ ngan ne la/ sku/ nas dkar/ dkar gtor/ gri thod bcas/ bar tshogs la/ las mgon yag pa la/ sku/ nas nag po/ dmar gtor gri thod rdo rje khaṭ+wāṃ/ nag chen la/ sku/ nas mthing*/ dmar gtor/ gri gug lcags drwa/ 'jigs byed can la/ sku/ nas sngo/ dmar gtor/ rdo rje bhan+dha/ bya gdong la/ sku/ nas (565)mthing*/ dmar gtor/ gri gug khaṭ+wāṃ/ gshog can la/ sku/ nas mthing*/ dmar gtor/ gri thod/ snying*/ dmar gtor/ 'od zer can la/ sku/ nas mthing*/ dmar gtor/ gri gug snying*/ ngo khro can la/ sku/ nas mthing*/ dmar gtor/ rdo rje thod khrag mig sdang can la/ sku/ nas mthing*/ gtor ma/ gri thod khaṭ+wāṃ zhags pa/ rgyu zhags can la/ sku/ nas sngo skya/ gtor ma/ gsal shing lcags kyu/ sbrul zhags can la/ sku/ nas mthing*/ gtor ma/ sbrul zhags bzhi/ thod rlon can la/ sku/ nas sngo/ dmar gtor gri thod khaṭ+wāṃ tsit+ta/ thod skam can la/ sku/ nas mthing*/ dmar gtor/ rdo rje bhan+dha me tog gri nor bu ne'u le/ bya rog gdong la/ sku/ nas mthing*/ dmar gtor/ gri thod bcas so/ dgong tshogs la/

'jam dpal phyag rtags spra ma'i skor la/ rtsa dbang ni/ bum pa/ rdo rje/ gtor ma/ 'jam dpal rigs drug la/ bum pa/ rdo rje/ gtor ma bcas/ bde mchog skor gyi dmar gtor la/ bum pa/ sku/ phreng ba/ gri thod/ phyi sgrub la dbang gong ltar/ nang sgrub la dbang de ltar/ gsang sgrub la dbang sngon ltar/ phur (566)pa la gzungs dbang*/ dur bdag la bka' gtad spyi 'gro/ sku/ nas dkar po/ dkar gtor gnyis/ thod dbyug bhan+dha bcas so// nyin dgu pa la/ gur drag chos skor gyi phyi sgrub la/ sku/ bum pa/ rdo rje ral gri khri gug sdig pa/ thod khrag khaṭ+wa/ gsang thod/ gtor ma bcas/ nang sgrub la/ sku/ bum pa/ rdo rje/ gri khug sdig pa/ thod khrag gsang thod/ gsang sgrub la/ sku/ bum pa/ rdo rje/ sdig pa/ gsang thod/ yang gsang la/ sku/ bum pa/ rdo rje/ lcags sdig gsang phod/ drag mthing gzungs dbang*/ rnga yab gling pa'i gzungs dbang*/ zab ston gzungs dbang*/ dgongs 'dus gzungs dbang*/ bla ma dgongs 'dus gzungs dbang*/ gro lod gzungs dbang bcas/ tsha rting la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ khyung khra'i gzungs dbang*/ 'jigs byed gzungs dbang*/ sdig pa'i gzungs dbang/ lok+t+ri zhi ba'i gzungs dbang*/ rgyas pa'i gzungs dbang*/ dbang gi gzungs dbang*/ drag po'i gzungs dbang*/ kun thub rgyal mo'i gzungs dbang*/ tshe bdag gzungs (567)dbang*/ dmag rgyal gzungs dbang*/ dgra rgyal gzungs dbang*/ tshogs rgyal gzungs dbang*/ nad rgyal gzungs dbang*/ bgegs rgyal gzungs dbang bcas/ bar tshogs la/ rdo rje 'bar ba/ sku/ nas dkar nag dmar gtor/ gri tsit+ta/ zhang blon la/ sku/ nas mthing*/ dmar gtor/ bing*/ lcags par/ zhing skyong la/ sku/ nas mthing dmar/ dmar gtor gtso 'khor bzhi pa/ ru mtshon snying*/ rol pa skya bdun la/ sku/ nas dmar gtor ma/ ba dan snying zhags/ ku be ra la/ sku nas mthing*/ dmar gtor/ ral gri/ sog ma med la/ sku/ nas ser/ lha bshos sbrul dkris/ nor bu/

jag me la/ sku/ nas dmar/ gtor ma/ mda' gzhu/ kong btsun la/ sku/ nas dkar/ gtor ma sman bshos bu khur/ mda' dar me long bcas/ dgong tshogs la/ khro bo ro za'i chos skor gyi rtsa dbang la/ mig dar/ g.yas kyi zung gtor/ dbus kyi zhal gtor/ dbus bum lag med/ mig dbye/ dkyil 'khor g.yas bum mchu can/ dung dkar/ me long (568)phyag mtshan tsaka li/ sku tsaka gtso bo/ rgyal chen bzhi/ sde brgyad re re bzhin/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo/ g.yon bum pa/ g.yon gyi bskrad gtor/ dung chu/ me dang chu/ ro za dmar po'i dbang bka' rgya can bskur na gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ rdo rje sgeg pa gzungs dbang*/ gur mgon gzungs dbang*/ re man+ta bka' gtad la/ sku/ nas dmar/ gtor ma ral gri lcags kyu bcas/ ro za'i gdon khrol la/ gser skyems gtor/ glud ljang gu shar du shing gseb bskyal/ glud dmar po lhod me la bsreg glud dkar po nub tu brag gseb sba/ glud sngon po byang du chu la dor/ ngar mi nag po khang steng bskyal/ ngar mi ser pos 'og sba/ tshon ljang*/ dmar/ dkar/ sngo/ nag ser/ rnams bla slob kyi mkhur tshos la byug sngags tshar gsum la ḍa 'ur gsum/ bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs bkra shis brjod/ ye shes 'jigs byed gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ rdo rje mchu gzungs dbang*/ ma hā ba la bka' gtad la/ sku/ nas mthing*/ dmar gtor/ tho ba/ zhags pa bcas so// nyin bcu pa la/ u pa ra tsa'i chos (569)skor gyi rtsa dbang la/ sku/ po ti/ thig le/ rma bya'i mdangs/ rgya gram/ me dpung bcas/ sku bzhi gcig dril gzungs dbang*/ thugs rje phyag gnyis gzungs dbang*/ phyag bzhi'i gzungs dbang*/ ḍoṃ bi'i gzungs dbang*/ pha dam pa'i gzungs dbang*/ nyi ma 'od zer gzungs dbang*/ rta mgrin gzungs dbang bcas/ tsha rting la/ g.yu sgron gzungs dbang*/ phag mo'i gzungs dbang*/ tshogs bdag gzungs dbang/ brag lha gzungs dbang*/ dzam dmar gzungs dbang*/ rnam sras gzungs dbang*/ rig 'dzin chen po gzungs dbang rgyas pa/

blo ldan mchog srid gzungs dbang*/ e ka dza ṭi'i gzungs dbang bcas so/ bar tshogs la/ rgyud bdag zhi bar gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ rgyas par gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ dbang la gzungs dbang*/ drag po'i gzungs dbang*/ rta mgrin bar chad kun sel gzungs dbang*/ khyung dmar chos skor gyi rtsa dbang la/ bum pa sku tsaka can/ po ti/ khroṃ yig bya tsaka li bcas/ nā ga rak+sha'i chos skor gyi rtsa bar gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ dgong tshogs la/ phur mjug chos skor gyi (570)gur drag phur mjug gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ gro lod gzungs dbang*/ bka' brgyad gzungs dbang*/ dgongs 'dus gzungs dbang*/ rdo gzhon gzungs dbang*/ khros ma gzungs dbang*/ seng gdong gzungs dbang*/ king kang gzungs dbang*/ khro chu gzungs dbang*/ drang srong gzungs dbang*/ re ti gzungs dbang*/ rta mgrin gzungs dbang bcas so// nyin bcu gcig par phag mo'i chos skor la/ spros bcas dbang la/ bum pa/ nor bu/ gri gug/ gri thod/ kha ṭaṃ/ nad gdon sel ba'i lha tsaka brgyad/ rim srung tsaka li bzhi pa la/ mda' dar dkar po la khro bo be ta yab yum brgyan pa g.yugs/ mda' dar ser po la khro bo sangs rgyas 'khor lo/ mda' dar dmar po la 'dre gsod rgyal po/ mda' dar ljang gu la lug bzhon rlung khrid tsaka li rnams kyi brgyan pa phyogs bzhir g.yugs/ phag mo spros med la dbang gong ltar la/ bum pa/ nor bu/ gri gug gri thod/ kha ṭ+waṃ bcas/ khros ma gzungs dbang*/ seng gdong gzungs dbang*/ lab sgron gzungs dbang*/ dme brtsegs gzungs dbang*/ nor rgyun gzungs dbang*/ dud sol lha mo'i gzungs dbang*/ re ti'i gzungs dbang*/ lha mo ri ma ti'i gzungs dbang*/ sngags (571)srung gzungs dbang bcas so// tsha rting la/ dmag zor gzungs dbang*/ khri sman gzungs dbang*/ dur bdag gzungs dbang*/ stag sman gzungs dbang*/ seng zhal gzungs dbang*/ ba lam gzungs dbang*/ gtum mo'i gzungs dbang*/ spyang zhon gzungs dbang*/

yi kha'i gzungs dbang*/ brtan ma'i gzungs dbang*/ dbang phyug gzungs dbang*/ kho le'i gzungs dbang*/ tshe ring mar bka' gtad rgyas pa/ sku lnga/ nas dkar/ sngo/ ser/ dmar/ ljang*/ dkar gtor gtso 'khor lnga pa/ rdo rje/ bum pa/ me long*/ nor bu/ mda' dar/ ne'u le/ mchod rten/ zas gzhong*/ sbrul zhags/ g.yu sgron phyi sgrub la/ sku/ nas dkar/ lha bshes/ nor bu me long*/ nang sgrub la/ sku/ nas ser po/ gtor ma zur gcig nor bu me long*/ gsang sgrub la/ sku/ nas dmar/ gtor ma tshogs lta bu/ mda' dar/ thod khrag yang gsang la/ sku/ nas ljang*/ gtor ma zur gnyis/ nor bu me long*/ dkar sgrub la/ sku/ nas dkar/ gtor ma dkar zlum/ mda' dar me long*/ nag sgrub la/ sku/ nas nag/ gtor nag zur gsum/ ral gri/ spu gri a go ra la/ sku/ nas nag (572)dmar gtor/ ru mtshon bhan+da bcas/ bar tshogs la/ sgrol ma'i chos skor gyi sgrol ljang la/ sku/ bum pa/ nas ljang*/ phreng ba/ rdo rje/ gtor ma/ ut+pal/ mtshon 'khor/ sgrol dkar la/ sku/ bum pa/ nas dkar/ shel phreng*/ rdo rje/ gtor ma/ ut+pal/ mtshon 'khor/ gro lod gzungs dbang*/ 'od zer can gzungs dbang*/ dpal mo thang nag gzungs dbang bcas/ las hur chos skor gyi zhi ba la/ bum pa/ gsang thod/ rdo rje/ rgyas par dbang*/ bum pa/ thod chang*/ rdo rje/ dbang la/ bum pa/ bdud rtsi/ rdo rje/ drag mo la/ bum pa/ thod chang*/ rdo rje/ mda' dar g.yab la 'gugs pa tshe brtan brjod do// dgong tshogs la/ g.yu grags gzungs dbang*/ khram grags gzungs dbang*/ nag drag gzungs dbang*/ 'grog chen gzungs dbang*/ shing gi skag zlog dbang*/ rlung zlog gzungs dbang*/ me zlog gzungs dbang*/ dgra zlog gzungs dbang*/ sa zlog gzungs dbang*/ lcags zlog gzungs dbang*/ gnam zlog gzungs dbang*/ chu zlog gzungs dbang*/ phyogs zlog gzungs dbang*/ zor gdong gzungs dbang*/ dred (573)gdong gzungs dbang*/ glang gdong gzungs dbang*/ chu srin gdong gzungs dbang*/

a phyi chos sgron gzungs dbang bcas so// nyin bcu gnyis par ma ning skor gyi/ dkar po la gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ dmar po'i gzungs dbang*/ mthing ga'i gzungs dbang*/ ser po'i gzungs dbang*/ ljang gu'i gzungs dbang*/ nag po'i gzungs dbang*/ glog phreng gzungs dbang*/ srog bdud gzungs dbang*/ sde brgyad gzungs dbang*/ ma ning las byang gzungs dbang bcas so// tsha rting la/ trak+shad gzungs dbang*/ phyag bzhi'i gzungs dbang*/ rtsa 'jib ma'i gzungs dbang*/ ber nag ye shes las dang 'jig rten mgon por/ gtor ma/ sngags phreng*/ thod khrag ber/ zhal sbyor gzungs dbang*/ myur mdzad phyag drug mgon dkar gzungs dbang*/ mgon mthing gzungs dbang*/ 'char ka'i gzungs dbang bcas/ bar tshogs la/ rnam sras ser chen gtor dbang*/ mdung dmar gtor dbang*/ lus ngan gtor dbang*/ tshe 'dzin gtor dbang*/ rta sngon gtor dbang*/ zangs ral gtor dbang*/ drag byed gtor dbang*/ ljang chung gtor dbang*/ sngon pa'i gtor dbang*/ ha (574)sagar+bha'i bka' gtad la/ sku/ bdud rtsi/ dmar gtor/ bsnyo kha la/ sku/ nas dud ka dmar gtor sbrul dkris gtso 'khor lnga pa/ 'khor lo sbrul zhags/ sprag btsan la/ sku/ nas dkar/ gtor ma/ mda' gzhu bcas so// dgong tshogs la/ ma ning tshogs gtor bsngo/ bskang ba'i 'phror/ bla mgon dbyer med/ bsgral las spyi rgyug la/ lcags hoṃ ling ga bkod/ g.yab dar phul/ bya 'ug sgro/ thun rdzas dug khrag yungs dkar nag ke shang*/ phur pa rnams gtad/ drang lhag thun gtor dus gsol ka gtor ma bskyang*/ chad tho zor du 'phang ba rnams dmigs bsal lo/ nyin bcu gsum pa la/ dzam la'i skor gyi dzam dkar la gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ dzam dmar gzungs dbang*/ dzam sngon gzungs dbang*/ dzam ser gzungs dbang*/ dzam ljang gzungs dbang*/ dzaṃ la nag po'i gzungs dbang*/ dzam khra dang po'i gzungs dbang*/ gnyis pa'i gzungs dbang*/ gsum pa'i gzungs dbang bcas/ tsha rting la/ rgyal chen yul 'khor srung gzungs dbang*/

'phags skyes po gzungs dbang*/ mig mi bzang gzungs dbang*/ rnam thos sras gzungs dbang*/ shar gyi rnam sras gzungs (575)dbang*/ lho'i gzungs dbang*/ nub kyi gzungs dbang*/ byang gi gzungs dbang*/ a par tsit+ta dang po'i gzungs dbang*/ gnyis pa'i gzungs dbang bcas so// phyi tshogs la/ gnod sbyin shan pa'i skor gyi phyi sgrub la/ sku/ sngags bya/ du yig bum pa/ gtor ma bcas/ ber brtsegs la dbang de ltar/ yam shud dbang de bzhin/ dmar nag pa tra'i rgya dbang gong ltar/ me ri'i rgya dbang gong bzhin/ snying rgya dbang gong 'dra/ zangs gri'i rgya dbang gong mtshungs/ dbang phyug chen po'i chos skyong gi rtsa dbang la gtor ma/ sku/ lcags kyu zhags pa/ ha yig bcas/ dgung tshogs la/ gza' hab sha'i skor las/ bka' gtad spyi rgyug la/ sku/ nas dud kha/ gtor ma/ ral gri sbrul zhags/ slob ma'i grangs mnyam sha dum khrag gis bran pa la dgra bgegs bkug la zar bcol rā hu la bka' gtad la/ sku/ nas dud ka gtor ma/ ral gri chu srin rgyal mtshan mda' gzhu sbrul zhags/ mgar nag la/ sku/ nas nag/ gtor ma/ tho ba sbud pa/ ngan ne zhi bar bka' gtad rgyas pa/ sku/ nas dkar/ gtor ma lha bshos/ gri thod/ khro mo la zhi ma khro bdun/ sku (576)nas dkar nag gtor ma zur gcig gri thod/ khro mo la/ sku/ nas nag gtor ma zur gnyis/ gri thod lcags dra nad rkyal/ shin tu khros la/ sku/ nas nag gtor ma zur gsum gri thod nad rkyal tshon gru lcags dra khram shing*/ dam can ral thod/ sku/ nas nag gtor ma mkhar thabs ra mgo/ ne'u le/ srin mgon nag po la/ sku/ me tog dmar po/ gtor ma thod dbyug bhan+dha/ mkha' gsang phyag rgya bca'/ dkar po la gong ltar dbang gi phyag mtshan gri thod/ ser po la dbang gong bzhin la phyag mtshan thod de dbyug bhan dmar/ dmar po la dbang gong ltar ral gri tsit+ta/ ljang gu la dbang gong mtshungs/ ru mtshon snying zhags/ ngom rgyal mtsho bkra la/ sku/ nas dkar/ gtor ma/

mdung dar nor bu bcas so// nyin bcu bzhi pa'i zhogs tshogs la/ dgongs gter skor gyi tshe dbang nam mkha'i nor bu la/ bum pa/ tshe gtor/ tshe chang ril/ me tog dmar po bcas/ kun rig la/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma rgya gram 'khor lo/ thun nag la/ lhung bzed/ byams pa la gtor ma/ sman bla la gtor ma/ thugs rje bzhengs sku la/ sku gzugs/ spyan gzigs sgyu dra la/ sku gzugs/ thugs rje nag (577)po la/ phreng ba nag po/ don yod zhags pa la gtor bcas/ tsha rting la/ sna tshogs yum la gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ bsil rgyun la/ chu shel/ bum pa/ dung chu/ phyag rdor utsa la gtor ma/ khyung khra la bdud rtsi/ yang dag la/ rdo rje dril bu/ bka' brgyad la/ bla gtor/ bum pa/ bdud rtsi/ dri thig mkha' 'gro gtor ma/ phur pa/ yi dam gtor ma khyung khra la bdud rtsi/ rta ljang la/ rta mgo nor bus mtshan pa/ drag mthing la/ gnam lcags rdo rje/ gro lod la/ bum pa/ gtor ma/ rab 'jigs la gzungs dbang bcas/ phyi tshogs la/ 'od zer can chags med dbang bsgrigs bskur na/ bum pa/ gtor ma/ dpal be'u/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ rgya mtshan/ gdugs/ bum pa/ dung*/ nya/ yang gtor ma bcas/ gter gzhung ltar na/ bum pa/ gtor ma/ phag mo la/ bla mas sdigs mdzub snying kar gtad/ khros ma la/ gri khug rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ de rnams phyogs bsdus/ seng gdong gzungs dbang*/ mu stegs seng gdong la phreng ba/ khro chu la/ bka' gtad spyi chings la/ sku/ nas mthing gtor ma/ dgra s+t+wa tsit+ta/ mgon po legs ldan la/ bing*/ bya bzhon la/ bum pa/ gtor ma/ gri khug khwaṭāṃ/ thod khrag snying*/ phyag (578)drug rigs lnga gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ trak+ṣad la gtor ma/ mi lha la/ sku bzhi re re bzhi/ nas dkar ser dmar ljang*/ gtor ma ril ba/ me thab bcas bka' gtad rgyas pa'i 'phro me thab la me sbar/ phye mar 'debs bcol/ khrag mdos bka' gtad la/ dmar gtor sku tsaka can/ re ti mched gsum la/ gtor ma/ ke'u ri brgyad la/

zhing dbyug mda' gzhu/ chu srin rgyal mtshan/ thod khrag rgyu zhags/ rgyu ma/ bai ro/ dug shing mar/ sku gzugs/ thang lha la bka' gtad spyi 'gro la/ sku/ nas dkar/ gtor ma sba lcag shel phreng*/ klu dga' bo la/ zan gyi sbrul/ lha chen dbang phyug la/ sngags byang bcas so// nyin bco lnga par them med bka' rgya ma'i skor la mtshan brgyad gcig dril la gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ gnam lcags zhun ma gzungs dbang*/ rdo rje bzhun byed gzungs dbang*/ pad+ma rgyal po gzungs dbang*/ ku ru kul+le gzungs dbang*/ 'jigs med rdo rje'i gzungs dbang bcas/ tsha rting la/ gshin rje 'ur len gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ king dmar gzungs dbang*/ king nag gzungs dbang*/ bhe ta li (579)gzungs dbang*/ ro lang gzungs dbang*/ gsod byed gzungs dbang*/ 'char kha gzungs dbang*/ sha za gzungs dbang*/ tshe brlag gzungs dbang bcas/ bar tshogs la/ 'jam dkar gzungs dbang rgyas pa/ ye shes grags phyi sgrub la bka' gtad rgyas pa/ sku/ nas mthing*/ gtor ma dkar gtor/ lcags kyu ne'u le/ yang gsang la bka' gtad bsdus pa/ sku/ nas ljang*/ dkar gtor/ nor bu/ nang sgrub la/ sku/ nas sngo/ dkar gtor/ lcags kyu/ ne'u le/ mdung dar/ phub/ gsang sgrub la/ sku/ nas nag po/ dkar gtor/ bum pa dang*/ ne'u le/ ye grags dkar po la/ sku/ nas dkar/ dkar gtor/ pi waṃ/ nor bu/ rnga/ mdung dar/ gur drag la gzungs dbang*/ 'dod rgyal la gzung dbang rgyas pa bcas/ dgong tshogs la/ spu gri mched gsum bka' gtad rgyas pa la/ sku/ nas sngo dmar/ dmar gtor gtso 'khor gsum pa/ ru mtshon gsum sbrul zhags mda' gzhung khram shing*/ mgar dmar bka' gtad/ sku/ nas dmar/ gtor mkhar thabs ra mgo/ rdo rje lcags kyu bhan+dha snying*/ k+ṣe tra pa la sku/ nas nag/ dmar gtor/ gri thod (580)gza' la/ sku/ nas dud ka/ gza' bshos/ mda' gzhu/ chu srin rgyal mtshan/ zhags pa/ las gshin la/ sku/ nas smug dmar gtor/ spu gri/ dgra snying*/ lha mo spyang zhon la/

sku/ nas nag dkar gtor/ khram shing nad rkyal/ bsam yas chos skyong gnod sbyin chen po tsi dmar la/ sku/ nas dmar/ dmar gtor/ mdung*/ zhags pa/ dbang phyug zor mdos bka' gtad la/ sku/ nas sna lnga/ gtor ma/ zangs gri dang thod khrag skong zor lnga re re bzhin phyogs gtsang dang*/ shar/ lho/ nub/ byang du 'phen du gzhug tshogs bskang rjes chog sngar ltar/ nyin bcu drug pa la mtha' rten dgongs gter tshe dkar chags med dbang gi rjes skyong ba la/ tshe mda'/ bum pa lan bzhi/ tshe gtor*/ tshe chang*/ tshe ril*/ shel phreng*/ me tog dkar po spyi bor bzhag oṃ gyi tsaka li/ āḥyi tsaka li/ hūm̐ gi tsaka li/ de bzhin du hrīḥ.oṃ/ a/ ma/ ra/ ṇi/ dzi/ wan/ ti/ ye/ swa hāḥ rnams kyi/ tsaka lis rim par rgyas gdab rab gnas bkra shis char 'bebs zur 'debs 'grel bas rdzas brgyad/ rtags brgyad/ sna bdun so sor tshig bcad lhug spel ma (581)rnams bya/ maṇ+ḍal bcas chags med pod dbang gi yi ge chos tshan yongs rdzogs kyis dbang bskur zhing pha dam pa'i smon lam sum cu lhan 'don bya'o// lha spyi'i mchod gtod gsol ka tshogs bskang rgyas par bya'o// pad+ma'i zab gter dgos 'byung mdzod khang de// gter ston re res cha shas bsgo skal khyer// yongs su rdzogs pa'i lde mig dbye mkhas pa// rig 'dzin chen po mi 'gyur rdo rje yin// rgyud lung man ngag bye ba'i 'byung gnas che// gnam chos thugs gter chen po 'dir bzhugs na// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'dod rgu'i dpal// rang dbang bsgyur la sam nyi'i skabs bral snyam// tshig gi snyan 'jab mu stegs la yang yod// yul gyi skad kyis don gyi gnad ston pa// thams cad mkhyen pa kho na'i khyad chos phyir// snying po'i lam 'di skye kun 'dzin gyur cig /tshes pa'ang rgyal dbang dpal yul ba'i 'du khang chen mo karma bkra shis bzhi pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe las slob rnams kyi bsnyil gsos su pad+ma ma ṇis bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
